purpose: After Iter463 qualified the leading source phases, test whether the exact source-specific P11*d_source factor admits a finite exponential-polynomial decomposition whose published Feynman boundary kernel 1/(x-rho-i*s*epsilon) has a canonical tempered-distribution pairing at nonzero beta. This is a one-dimensional spectral pairing gate only.
source_formula_lock: Use exactly the Iter460/463 d_source and degree-3 P11 formulas. Preserve denominator x-rho-i*s*epsilon. No beta+i*epsilon, damping, fitted subtraction, counterterm, contour deformation chosen after results, or coefficient fitting.
exact_identity: P11(x;rho)/(x+x^3) = -i/((i*rho+1)(i*rho)(i*rho-1)) for rho != 0, so P11*d_source must reduce exactly to finitely many x^n exp(i*sigma*beta*x) channels with n<=2 and sigma in {-1,+1}.
distribution_rule: For beta>0, k=sigma*beta != 0 and z=rho+i*s*epsilon, define J_n(k,z)=<exp(i*k*x), x^n/(x-z)> in the standard tempered/Feynman boundary sense. Polynomial division plus the Fourier transform of polynomials away from k=0 gives J_n=z^n J_0, and J_0=2*pi*i*sign(k)*exp(i*k*z) when k*Im(z)>0, else 0. Therefore epsilon->0+ selects only sigma=s and yields J_n=2*pi*i*s*rho^n*exp(i*s*beta*rho).

interpretation.scope: PASS qualifies only the exact source P11*d_source pairing with the one-dimensional published spectral Feynman boundary kernel on the frozen panel. It does not prove full causal-vertex finiteness, absolute integrability, multi-variable pullback validity, D7-S2 closure by itself, or any terminal D7 classifier. Candidate Gravity remains inactive.
